Hero.description: I build web and mobile apps that just work — clean, fast, and easy to use. I love turning ideas into reality and solving real problems for people.

About.title: About Me

paragraphs.one: I got into fullstack development because I wanted to build things that actually help people. What started as curiosity is now my profession — building web and mobile apps that just get the job done, without over-complicating things.
paragraphs.two: These days I work as a Software Engineer at adesso, building tailored software for companies and public organisations. Before that I led a small engineering team at apomap — where I learned that clear code and clear communication matter equally.
paragraphs.three: I believe technology should solve real problems simply and reliably. That belief carries into my own products too — like ElliesNote, a health companion for people living with energy-limiting chronic conditions.
paragraphs.four: Every project is a new chance to learn and make a difference, and I’m excited to keep growing — as an engineer, a teammate, and a builder.
